In addition to the blog posts on the site, we are compiling larger, end-to-end
guides and tutorials show you how to weave these tools together in your analyses.

<br>
<br>

[Quarto Book: A Guide to Whole Transcriptome CosMx<sup>&#174;</sup> SMI Analysis](the-wtx-guide/index.html) 

::: columns
::: {.column width="65%"}

This is 
an end-to-end workflow that walks through analyzing a publicly-available WTX single slide dataset 
-- from loading flat files
to quality processing to performing Pathway analysis -- using open-sourced tools in a blend of R and python. In here 
you will find best practices, interactive visualizations to show what effects
certain processing parameters have on the data, and applications to cutting-edge
tools that have described in our blog like HieraType. 

:::
